# Client Kickoff Questionnaire — [Project Name]

> **Purpose:** Structured set of questions for the BA to ask at project kickoff or client onboarding. Work through each section in order. Record answers directly in this document — it feeds the Glossary, Assumptions Log, Stakeholder Register, and Project Charter.
> **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
> **Attendees:** [List names and roles]
> **Conducted by:** [BA Name]

---

## 1. Project & Business Context

> Goal: Understand why this project exists and what success looks like.

**1.1** What problem are we solving? What is happening today that is causing pain?
> _Answer:_

**1.2** Who are the primary end users of this system? What do they need to be able to do?
> _Answer:_

**1.3** What does success look like in 6 months? In 12 months? What would tell you this project delivered value?
> _Answer:_

**1.4** What is the business impact of NOT doing this project, or doing it too slowly?
> _Answer:_

**1.5** Are there any competing initiatives or dependencies we should know about?
> _Answer:_

---

## 2. Stakeholders & Decision Making

> Goal: Know who has authority, who to go to for what, and who needs to be kept informed.

**2.1** Who has final sign-off authority on requirements and scope decisions?
> _Answer:_

**2.2** Who approves Change Requests before development begins?
> _Answer:_

**2.3** Who is the day-to-day point of contact for questions during development?
> _Answer:_

**2.4** Who needs to be involved in User Acceptance Testing (UAT)?
> _Answer:_

**2.5** Are there any stakeholders who are not in this meeting but whose input will be needed?
> _Answer:_

**2.6** What is the expected turnaround time for responses to BA questions or document reviews?
> _Answer:_

---

## 3. Domain & Regulatory

> Goal: Surface constraints the system must comply with that will shape all requirements.

**3.1** What industry or domain does this system operate in? Are there specific regulations we must comply with?
> _Answer:_

**3.2** Are there data protection or privacy requirements (e.g. GDPR, local data residency laws)?
> _Answer:_

**3.3** Are there licensing, AML, KYC, or other financial/legal compliance obligations?
> _Answer:_

**3.4** Are there audit or reporting obligations the system must support?
> _Answer:_

**3.5** Are there specific security standards or certifications required (e.g. ISO 27001, PCI DSS)?
> _Answer:_

---

## 4. Existing Systems & Integrations

> Goal: Understand what the new system must connect to and what constraints that creates.

**4.1** What existing systems does this project need to integrate with?
> _Answer:_

**4.2** For each integration: is there an existing API, or will we need to build one? Who owns it?
> _Answer:_

**4.3** Are there existing databases or data sources the system must read from or write to?
> _Answer:_

**4.4** Are there third-party services or vendors already contracted (e.g. payment providers, notification services)?
> _Answer:_

**4.5** What happens if an integration is unavailable? Is offline or degraded mode required?
> _Answer:_

---

## 5. Scope & Constraints

> Goal: Define the boundaries clearly upfront to prevent scope creep.

**5.1** What is explicitly OUT of scope for this project? What are we definitely NOT building?
> _Answer:_

**5.2** Are there technical constraints we must work within (platform, technology stack, hosting environment)?
> _Answer:_

**5.3** What are the most critical features that must be ready for the first release (MVP)?
> _Answer:_

**5.4** Are there hard deadlines we must hit? What is driving those dates?
> _Answer:_

**5.5** Are there budget constraints that would affect scope or approach?
> _Answer:_

**5.6** Are there geographic or language/localisation requirements?
> _Answer:_

---

## 6. Existing Documentation & Prior Work

> Goal: Avoid duplicating work and surface any existing knowledge we should build on.

**6.1** Is there any existing documentation — specs, wireframes, user stories, previous BRs, research?
> _Answer:_

**6.2** Has a version of this system been built before (internally or by a third party)? What can we learn from it?
> _Answer:_

**6.3** Has the client worked with an external development partner before? What worked well or poorly?
> _Answer:_

**6.4** Are there any known pain points or failed past attempts we should be aware of?
> _Answer:_

---

## 7. Communication & Working Preferences

> Goal: Agree on how we work together day-to-day.

**7.1** What is the preferred communication channel for day-to-day questions? (Email / Slack / WhatsApp / other)
> _Answer:_

**7.2** What meeting cadence works best for regular status calls? (Weekly / twice-weekly / bi-weekly)
> _Answer:_

**7.3** Who should receive written status updates and how often?
> _Answer:_

**7.4** How should we handle urgent questions or blockers that arise between scheduled calls?
> _Answer:_

**7.5** Is the client comfortable reviewing and signing documents digitally, or is a physical process required?
> _Answer:_

---

## 8. UAT & Go-Live

> Goal: Align on how we validate the system before launch and what go-live looks like.

**8.1** Who from the client side will perform UAT? Do they have technical experience?
> _Answer:_

**8.2** Will we use a staging environment for UAT? Who is responsible for providing test data?
> _Answer:_

**8.3** What are the go-live criteria — what must be true before the system goes live?
> _Answer:_

**8.4** Is there a plan for post-launch support? Who handles production issues after go-live?
> _Answer:_

**8.5** Are there any blackout periods when releases cannot happen (e.g. financial year-end, peak seasons)?
> _Answer:_
